sentence_stem: Had the methodology been more rigorous,
correct_completion: the authors' conclusions would have carried far greater weight.
full_sentence: Had the methodology been more rigorous, the authors' conclusions would have carried far greater weight.
acceptable_variants: the findings would have been far more persuasive.
the paper would have been received with greater confidence.

options.text: the authors' conclusions carry far greater weight now.
options.why_wrong: The inverted past conditional refers to an unrealised past situation, so a present-tense result does not complete it.

options.text: the authors' conclusions would have carried far greater weight.
it had been rigorous enough to satisfy the reviewers.
options.why_wrong: This repeats a past condition instead of stating the hypothetical result the stem requires.

options.text: so the reviewers were satisfied with the conclusions.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a real consequence that has already occurred, not the unrealised result of a counterfactual condition.

grammar_focus: Inverted third conditional with 'had' and the modal perfect 'would have carried'
explanation: The inverted form 'Had + subject + past participle' replaces 'if', so the main clause needs a modal perfect expressing the result that would have followed.
translation: Se a metodologia tivesse sido mais rigorosa, as conclusões dos autores teriam peso muito maior.
